subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should Clownfish adopt a warmed workspace backend for bulk issue clusters, and if so should the first implementation target mitos directly, a crabbox fork-warmed-lease primitive, or a repository-local abstraction?
rationale: The source tree does not provide this architecture today, and the implementation choice affects runner backend, checkout lifecycle, credentials, cache policy, cleanup, and operational safety beyond a narrow fix.

options.title: Prototype opt-in lease backend
options.body: Add a default-off warmed workspace lease abstraction and prove it on one target repo before broad rollout.

options.title: Keep ordinary checkouts
options.body: Leave the issue open or iceboxed until setup cost data justifies adding a new runner backend.

options.title: Split a design spike
options.body: Create a narrower design task that compares mitos and crabbox lease semantics before implementation work starts.

recommendation.title: Prototype opt-in lease backend
recommendation.body: Add a default-off warmed workspace lease abstraction and prove it on one target repo before broad rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the merged target-checkout work most closely adjacent to this proposed runner architecture.
